procedural_matters: GBR 2213 was represented by Tom Bayliss GER 27 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: At the time of the incident, the wind was 15 knots, with choppy waves.
GER 27, close-hauled on port tack and 4 boat lengths below the port-tack lay line to Mark 1, was on a course to collide bow to bow with GBR 2213, close-hauled on the starboard-tack lay line.
When the two bows were 2m apart, GBR 2213 luffed and tacked to leeward of GER 27.
When GBR 2213 reached a close-hauled course, the boats were separated by 40cm.
Neither boat took a Two-Turn Penalty at that stage.
GER 27 subsequently made contact with Mark 1a, and thereafter took a One-Turn-Penalty.
conclusions: GER 27 on port tack failed to keep clear of GBR 2213 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
GER 27 touched mark 1a and broke RRS 31.
Since RRS 44.1(b) did not apply, GER 27 took an applicable penalty by One-Turn Penalty for breaking RRS 31.
decision: DECISION Protest Request No.: 02 GER 27 is DSQ in race #3.
